units.source_text: 薰大将也非常关念宇治情况，不堪其忧，便亲赴宇治来探视。

en.t: General Kaoru too was deeply concerned about affairs at Uji, and unable to bear his anxiety, he went there in person to see for himself.

units.source_text: 他一路上回思昔日种种事情：“当初我由于何种宿缘而来访问她们的父亲八亲王呢？

en.t: On the way he thought back over many things from the past: What bond from a former life first brought me to visit their father, the Eighth Prince?

units.source_text: 后来竟替他全家的人操心，连这个意想不到的弃女也照顾到。

en.t: Afterward I ended up worrying over his whole household, and even came to look after this unexpected abandoned daughter.

units.source_text: 我之来此，本是欲向这位道行高深的先辈请教佛法，替自身后世修福。

en.t: I originally came here to learn the Buddhist law from that deeply devout elder, and to cultivate merit for my own future life.

units.source_text: 不意后来违背素志，动了凡心。

en.t: Unexpectedly, I later betrayed my original intention and let worldly passion arise in me.

units.source_text: 大约正是为此而身受佛菩萨惩罚吧。”

en.t: It must be for that very reason that I am now being punished by the Buddhas and bodhisattvas.

units.source_text: 到了山庄，他就召唤右近，对她说道：“此间情状，我所闻知的很不清楚。

en.t: When he reached the mountain villa, he summoned Ukon and said to her, What I have heard about matters here is very unclear.

units.source_text: 这真是无限伤心之事！

en.t: This is truly a matter of boundless sorrow.

units.source_text: 七七丧忌余日不多，我本想于丧忌过后来访，然而不能自制，就匆匆地来了。

en.t: Only a few days remain in the forty-nine-day mourning period, and I had meant to come after it was over, but I could not restrain myself and hurried here.

units.source_text: 小姐毕竟患了什么病症，而如此突然亡身？”

en.t: What illness did the young lady suffer from, that she should die so suddenly?

units.source_text: 右近见问，想道：“小姐横死之事，老尼姑弁君等也都知道。

en.t: When Ukon was questioned, she thought, The young lady's unnatural death is known to the old nun Ben no Kimi and the others as well.

units.source_text: 将来总会被大将闻知。

en.t: Sooner or later the general is bound to hear of it.

units.source_text: 我倘隐瞒了他，将来他听见别人所说不同，反而要怪怨我。

en.t: If I hide it from him, and later he hears a different account from someone else, he will blame me all the more.

units.source_text: 所以应该对他直说。”

en.t: So I ought to tell him the truth directly.

units.source_text: 至于浮舟和匂亲王的秘密事件，右近曾煞费苦心地隐瞒，并且预先准备：如果面对这位态度异常严肃的薰大将，应该说怎样怎样的话。

en.t: As for the secret affair between Ukifune and Prince Niou, Ukon had taken great pains to conceal it, and had prepared in advance what she should say if she faced this unusually stern General Kaoru.

units.source_text: 然而今天真个看见了他，准备好的话全都忘记了。

en.t: Yet when she actually saw him today, she forgot all the words she had prepared.

units.source_text: 她不胜狼狈，便把浮舟失踪前后情况如实告诉了他。

en.t: Overcome with confusion, she told him truthfully what had happened before and after Ukifune's disappearance.

units.source_text: 薰大将听了，觉得这真是意想不到之事，一时说不出话来。

en.t: When General Kaoru heard this, he felt it was utterly unexpected and for a time could say nothing.

units.source_text: 他想：“决不会真有这种事情！

en.t: He thought, Such a thing cannot possibly be true.

units.source_text: 浮舟沉默寡言，一般人常说的话她也不肯多说，真是个温柔的淑女，怎么可能痛下决心而做出如此可怕之事？

en.t: Ukifune was quiet and spoke little, unwilling even to say what ordinary people say so readily; she was such a gentle lady, so how could she steel herself to do something so dreadful?

units.source_text: 多半是这些侍女捏造事实来欺骗我。”

en.t: Most likely these attendants have invented the story to deceive me.

units.source_text: 他疑心匂亲王把浮舟隐藏起来，心中愈加烦乱了。

en.t: He suspected that Prince Niou had hidden Ukifune away, and his heart grew still more troubled.

units.source_text: 然而回想匂亲王哀悼之色，分明是真实的。

en.t: Yet when he recalled Prince Niou's look of mourning, it was plainly genuine.

units.source_text: 看这里的侍女们的模样，如果是假装哀悼，自然看得出来。

en.t: Looking at the attendants here, if their grief were feigned, it would naturally be visible.

units.source_text: 此时山庄中上下人等闻知薰大将来到，大家伤心起来，一齐号啕大哭。

en.t: At that moment, when everyone high and low in the villa heard that General Kaoru had arrived, they were overcome with grief and all wailed aloud together.

units.source_text: 薰大将听到了，问道：“有没有与小姐一同失踪的人？

en.t: General Kaoru heard them and asked, Was there anyone who disappeared together with the young lady?

units.source_text: 还得把当时情况详细告诉我！

en.t: You must also tell me in detail what happened at the time.

units.source_text: 我想小姐决不会嫌我冷淡而背弃我。

en.t: I do not think the young lady would ever abandon me because she thought me cold.

units.source_text: 究竟突然发生了什么不可告人之事，因而投身赴水？

en.t: What secret, unspeakable thing could suddenly have happened to make her throw herself into the water?

units.source_text: 我始终不能相信。”

en.t: I simply cannot believe it.

units.source_text: 右近看薰大将可怜；又见他果然怀疑，颇感为难，便对他说：“大人当然知道：我家小姐自幼不幸，生长穷乡。

en.t: Ukon pitied General Kaoru, and seeing that he did indeed suspect something, she felt deeply troubled and said to him, As you know, my lady was unfortunate from childhood and grew up in the countryside.

units.source_text: 近又僻处在这荒寂的山庄中。

en.t: Recently she had been living in seclusion in this desolate mountain villa.

units.source_text: 自此以后，平居常多愁闷。

en.t: After that, even in ordinary times she was often sorrowful and gloomy.

units.source_text: 惟静候大人偶尔降临，是其乐事，竟可使她忘怀过去之不幸。

en.t: Her only pleasure was quietly waiting for your occasional visits, which could even make her forget the misfortunes of her past.

units.source_text: 她希望早日迁京，安居逸处，时时侍奉左右，口虽不言，心中无时或忘。

en.t: She hoped to move to the capital soon, live there peacefully, and serve near you always; though she never said so aloud, she never forgot it in her heart.

units.source_text: 后来闻得此事即将如愿，我们当侍女的人也都欢喜庆幸，忙于准备乔迁。

en.t: Later, when we heard that this wish was about to be fulfilled, we attendants were all delighted and busied ourselves preparing for the move.

units.source_text: 那位常陆守夫人得遂长年之志，更是兴高采烈，日夜筹划乔迁之事。

en.t: The wife of the Governor of Hitachi, having achieved her long-held wish, was even more overjoyed and planned the move day and night.

units.source_text: 岂知后来大人来了一封莫名其妙的信。

en.t: But then, unexpectedly, a puzzling letter came from you.

units.source_text: 这里守夜人也来传达尊意，说侍女中有放肆之人，警卫必须森严。

en.t: The night watchman here also came to convey your orders, saying that there was an insolent person among the attendants and that security had to be strict.

units.source_text: 那些不通情理的粗暴村夫，竟有妄猜瞎测，乱造谣言者。

en.t: Those crude villagers, who understood nothing of proper feeling, began making wild guesses and spreading baseless rumors.

units.source_text: 而此后大人久无音信。

en.t: After that, there was no word from you for a long time.

units.source_text: 于是小姐痛感自身自幼不幸，顿萌绝望之念。

en.t: Then my lady felt keenly that she had been unfortunate since childhood, and suddenly fell into despair.

units.source_text: 母夫人一向用尽心力，务求女儿交运纳福，不落人后。

en.t: Her mother had always devoted all her efforts to ensuring that her daughter would meet good fortune and not fall behind others.

units.source_text: 小姐此时觉得妄图幸福，反受世人讪笑，实甚伤心，于是沦入悲观，日夜愁叹。

en.t: At this point my lady felt that by vainly seeking happiness she had only become an object of ridicule, and she was deeply hurt, sinking into despair and lamenting day and night.

units.source_text: 除了上述情况之外，竟想不出其他致死之原因。

en.t: Apart from what I have just described, I can think of no other cause that led to her death.

units.source_text: 即使被鬼怪隐藏了，也总得留些痕迹。”

en.t: Even if she had been hidden away by some spirit, there should still have been some trace left behind.

units.source_text: 说罢掩面大哭，悲伤不已。

en.t: After saying this, she covered her face and wept loudly, unable to contain her grief.

units.source_text: 薰大将便不再怀疑，悲从中来，泪流不止。

en.t: General Kaoru no longer doubted her; grief welled up inside him, and his tears would not stop.

units.source_text: 他说：“我身不能随意作为，一举一动都受人注目。

en.t: He said, I cannot act freely as I wish; every movement I make draws people's attention.

units.source_text: 每逢挂念她时，总是想道：不久即将迎她入京，使她有名有目，无忧无虑，和我永远欢聚。

en.t: Whenever I thought of her, I always told myself that before long I would bring her to the capital, give her a recognized place, free her from worry, and live happily with her forever.

units.source_text: 全靠以此自慰，过了许多日子。

en.t: Relying on that thought to comfort myself, I passed many days.

units.source_text: 她疑心我疏远她，而实际是她抛舍了我。

en.t: She suspected that I had grown distant from her, but in truth it was she who cast me aside.

units.source_text: 真使我好伤心啊！

en.t: How deeply she has wounded me.

units.source_text: 有一件事，本来今日我已不想再提，但此间别无外人，不妨说说，这便是匂亲王之事。

en.t: There is one matter I had not intended to raise again today, but since there are no outsiders here, I may as well speak of it: the matter of Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 他和小姐究竟是几时开始往来的？

en.t: When exactly did he and the young lady begin seeing each other?

units.source_text: 这位亲王对于色情之事特具专长，善于诱惑女人之心。

en.t: That prince is especially skilled in affairs of love and knows well how to entice a woman's heart.

units.source_text: 我料想小姐是为了不能常常和他相逢，不堪悲伤，因而投身自尽的。

en.t: I suppose the young lady could not bear the grief of being unable to meet him often, and so threw herself into the water and took her own life.

units.source_text: 你须得如实告我，对我不可隐瞒！”

en.t: You must tell me the truth and hide nothing from me.

units.source_text: 右近想道：“他确已完全知道了！”

en.t: Ukon thought, He truly knows everything already.

units.source_text: 不胜遗憾，答道：“这件深可痛心之事，原来大人已经闻知了？

en.t: Deeply distressed, she replied, So you have already heard of this terribly painful matter, my lord?

units.source_text: 我右近是时刻不离小姐左右的……”

en.t: I, Ukon, was always at the young lady's side and never left her.

units.source_text: 她略想一想，又说：“大人当然知道，小姐曾经悄悄地到亲王夫人那里住过几天。

en.t: After thinking for a moment, she continued, As you know, my lady once quietly stayed for several days at the residence of the prince's wife.

units.source_text: 有一天，没料到亲王闯进了小姐室内。

en.t: One day, unexpectedly, the prince forced his way into my lady's room.

units.source_text: 经我们严词抗拒，他终于走了出去。

en.t: After we firmly resisted him, he finally left.

units.source_text: 小姐害怕了，就迁居到三条地方那所简陋的屋子里。

en.t: My lady became frightened and moved to that modest house in the Sanjo area.

units.source_text: 此后亲王见音信全无，就不再来纠缠了。

en.t: After that, when the prince saw that there was no response at all, he stopped pestering her.

units.source_text: 小姐来此之后，不知他从何处闻知消息，派人送信来，这正是二月间之事。

en.t: After my lady came here, he somehow learned where she was and sent someone with a letter; this was in the second month.

units.source_text: 以后又有好几次来信，但小姐看也不看。

en.t: Afterward several more letters came, but my lady would not even look at them.

units.source_text: 我等劝她：‘置之不理，太不礼貌了，反而显得小姐不懂情理。’

en.t: We urged her, saying, To ignore them is far too discourteous, and will instead make you appear unreasonable.

units.source_text: 于是小姐作复，大约有一二次吧。

en.t: So my lady replied, perhaps once or twice.

units.source_text: 除此以外，我们并没有看到别的事情。”

en.t: Apart from that, we saw nothing else.

units.source_text: 薰大将听了，想道：“她的回答总不过如此，我强欲深究，也太乏味了。”

en.t: Hearing this, General Kaoru thought, Her answer amounts to no more than this, and it would be too futile to force the matter further.

units.source_text: 于是俯首沉思，他想：“浮舟珍视匂亲王，对他倾心爱慕。

en.t: He lowered his head in thought and reflected, Ukifune cherished Prince Niou and loved him with all her heart.

units.source_text: 另一方面对我毕竟也不能忘情，以致左右为难，无法解决。

en.t: On the other hand, she could not forget her feelings for me either, and so she was caught between us with no way to resolve it.

units.source_text: 她本来优柔寡断，又值居近水边，就起了这个念头。

en.t: She was indecisive by nature, and because she happened to live near the water, this thought came to her.

units.source_text: 如果我不把她安置在家里，即使她遭逢极大的忧患，未必能找到一个‘深谷’而投身自杀。

en.t: If I had not placed her in that house, then even if she had met with the greatest sorrow, she might not have found a deep valley in which to throw herself away.

units.source_text: 如此看来，这水实甚可恨！”

en.t: Seen in this way, this water is truly hateful.

units.source_text: 他便深恶痛疾这宇治川。

en.t: He therefore came to hate the Uji River with bitter intensity.

units.source_text: 他近年来为了那可怜的大女公子和这浮舟，奔走往返于崎岖的山路上，如今回想起了觉得可哀。

en.t: In recent years he had gone back and forth over rugged mountain roads for the sake of the pitiful elder princess and now for Ukifune, and looking back on it he felt it was sorrowful.

units.source_text: 连“宇治”这个地名他也不愿再闻了。

en.t: He no longer even wished to hear the place name Uji.

units.source_text: 又想：“匂亲王夫人最初向我提出此人时，把她比作大女公子的雕像，已是不祥之兆。

en.t: He also thought, When Prince Niou's wife first brought this woman to my attention and compared her to an image of the elder princess, that was already an ill omen.

units.source_text: 总之，此人完全是由于我的疏忽而亡身的。”

en.t: In the end, this woman lost her life entirely because of my negligence.

units.source_text: 他想来想去，想到了浮舟的葬仪，觉得这母亲毕竟身份低微，女儿的后事办得如此草率，实甚遗憾。

en.t: As he thought it over and over, he remembered Ukifune's funeral and felt deeply sorry that, because her mother was of low rank, her daughter's final rites had been handled so hastily.

units.source_text: 听了右近的详细报道，又想：“做母亲的定然非常悲伤吧。

en.t: After hearing Ukon's detailed report, he thought again, Her mother must surely be grieving terribly.

units.source_text: 浮舟作为这样一个母亲的女儿，总算是出类拔萃的人物了。

en.t: For the daughter of such a mother, Ukifune was, after all, an outstanding person.

units.source_text: 浮舟与匂亲王的秘密事情，做母亲的未必闻知。

en.t: Her mother probably did not know about the secret affair between Ukifune and Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 她定然以为我对浮舟的关系有何变卦，因而使她自杀，正在怨恨我呢。”

en.t: She must think that something changed in my relationship with Ukifune and that this drove her to suicide, and she must be resenting me now.

units.source_text: 便觉万分对她不起。

en.t: He felt profoundly sorry toward her.
